quarters.source: SUMCO official issuer consolidated financial results linked by issuer IR feed
quarters.basis: Japanese GAAP consolidated; nine-month cumulative less first-half cumulative; FST included in both income statements
quarters.sourcePrecision: Whole million JPY, rounded down by issuer; subtraction retains reported million precision
quarters.sourceLocation: Q3 PDF page 1 and Q2 PDF page 1, consolidated operating results

calculation.method: Comparable nine-month cumulative minus first-half cumulative
calculation.basisCheck: Q3 page 1 expressly states FST remains included in the nine-month income statement despite equity-method reclassification in the September 30 balance sheet. Thus cumulative subtraction remains comparable. Both Q2 and Q3 report no policy/estimate changes or restatement. FST sales and operating income are excluded only from Q4 onward.

TSE:3436.financialNote: 공식 일본회계기준 연결 누계(9개월−6개월)로 산출한 7~9월 단독분기입니다. FST는 9월 말 재무상태표에서 연결 제외됐지만 1~9월 손익에는 포함되어 차감 기준이 같습니다. FST 매출·영업이익의 연결 제외는 4분기부터 적용됩니다.

quarters.source: Resonac official issuer financial results presentation; statutory IFRS operating profit, not core operating profit
quarters.basis: IFRS consolidated continuing operations excluding Crasus Chemical; directly reported standalone Q3; scope differs from preserved previous observations
quarters.sourcePrecision: 0.1 billion JPY as reported; multiplied by 1000 to million JPY, no extra precision claimed

calculation.method: Directly reported standalone quarter, unit conversion only; no subtraction of incompatible cumulative values
calculation.basisCheck: Crasus Chemical classified as discontinued operation retrospectively from start of fiscal year. Old H1 676852/73310 million includes that business and must not be subtracted from new nine-month 871853/148350 million.

quarters.comparabilityNote: 2026 Q3 excludes Crasus Chemical. Preserved Q2, Q1 and 2025 Q4 are historical as-reported observations including that business and are not directly comparable; do not compute quarter-on-quarter or year-on-year growth across this scope break.

TSE:4004.financialNote: 공식 설명자료의 IFRS 계속사업 7~9월 단독분기이며 코어 영업이익이 아닙니다. 원문 0.1십억 JPY 정밀도를 백만 JPY로 환산했습니다. Crasus Chemical 중단사업을 제외한 수치로, 기존에 보존된 이전 분기(해당 사업 포함)와 연결 범위가 달라 직접 전분기·전년 비교하면 안 됩니다.
